rows.definition: The default Mode value PlanProviderActionsWithOptions sets on ProviderActionTransport, declaring the provider vcache action plan is advisory-only until a witnessed heartbeat or explicit-cache transport proves byte-identical-prefix and provider deletion capability (the other mode is witnessed_transport).
rows.distinction: It is a TRANSPORT-READINESS mode string carried on the provider action plan (decision_only vs witnessed_transport), not a governor policy verdict like GovernorDecision or a vCache governor action label (ride_natural/heartbeat_pin/lazy_rebuild).

rows.definition: The single worst-first WorkItem superloop.Drive selects to enter for this invocation: a pure fold over a completed WalkReport carrying Enter, the chosen Member, its Rank (always 1), Action hint, and Satisfied/IssueShortfall so a caller's exit check reads clean only when the walk is truly met.
rows.distinction: It is the super loop's PER-INVOCATION worst-first selection over member work, not the dispatcher's per-issue routing tier pick (TierDecision) nor an account-pool rotation pick (NextRotationDecision).

rows.definition: The Registry method behind account rotation that returns the full RotationDecision (chosen Seat, OK, and a closed Reason distinguishing an empty pool from a single-bucket pool from an all-others-walled pool, plus the anchor's own room state) so a caller can explain WHY rotation found nothing instead of recomputing the plan.
rows.distinction: It is the account-pool ROTATION pick with a self-explaining refusal reason, not the super loop's worklist selection (DriveDecision) nor the gateway's guardroute request-routing pick (RouteDecision).

rows.definition: One routing decision the dispatcher made for an issue (Issue, Chosen tier, Required risk floor, Optimal fit) that Calibrate joins against a WitnessedOutcome to classify over-tier versus under-tier dispatch calibration.
rows.distinction: It is the CALIBRATION record joining a dispatched tier choice to its later witnessed outcome, not the session decision-log renderer package (taskdecision) nor the super loop's worklist pick (DriveDecision).
